applyTo: "**/*.md"
description: How documentation in this repository is written.
---

# Documentation conventions

- Lead with what the reader will be able to do, then how. No preamble about how
  important the topic is.
- Every lesson file in `docs/` opens with **Time**, **You will learn**, and
  **You will need**, in that order.
- Code fences always name the language.
- When you tell the reader to type something into Copilot Chat, put the prompt
  in a blockquote on its own so it is copy-pasteable and visually distinct from
  narration.
- Screenshots are fine, but every screenshot must also be described in text.
  Half this team reads these docs on a phone between inspections.
- Do not use the word "simply". If a step is simple it does not need saying,
  and if it is not, the word is a lie.
